bullets.text: The Lions, Bears and Vikings are all 7-2, turning the NFC North into a three-way race.
The Ravens have lost five straight and sit at 4-6, a slide that included a loss to the previously winless Chargers.
The Broncos (7-2) and 49ers (8-1) have strong records, but point differentials of +12 and +85 say they are less dominant than that.

reasons: NFC North lead on the line
